description: This file defines the NetworkStatusService class, which provides an asynchronous method to fetch the current network status on iOS devices. It uses NWPathMonitor from the Network framework to observe network path changes, with a fallback mechanism in case of timeout. It also includes a private NetworkStatusState class to manage synchronization state.

classes.name: NetworkStatusService
classes.description: A service class that provides network status information asynchronously.

classes.name: NetworkStatusState
classes.description: A private class used internally to track the completion state of network monitoring operation.

methods.name: currentStatus
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current network status with a specified timeout.

methods.name: payload
methods.description: Creates a payload of network status information from an NWPath object.

methods.name: fallbackPayload
methods.description: Creates a default network status payload when monitoring times out.

methods.name: markCompleted
methods.description: Marks the network status check as completed in a thread-safe manner.
